tools.name: invite_team_member_to_subscription
tools.description: Grants a person access to a team subscription with the given role and emails them an invitation to join. Records the new member's role on the subscription.

params.name: invitee_email
params.description: Email address of the person to invite

params.name: role
params.description: Role to grant, such as member, billing_admin or owner

tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage

from agents import tool


@tool
def invite_team_member_to_subscription(subscription_id: str, invitee_email: str, role: str) -> str:
    allowed_roles_for_invitation = {"member", "billing_admin", "owner"}
    if role not in allowed_roles_for_invitation:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported role: {role}")

    database_connection = sqlite3.connect("billing.db")
    try:
        database_connection.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO subscription_members (subscription_id, email, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (subscription_id, invitee_email, role),
        )
        database_connection.commit()
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

    invitation_email_message = EmailMessage()
    invitation_email_message["From"] = "billing@example.com"
    invitation_email_message["To"] = invitee_email
    invitation_email_message["Subject"] = "You have been invited to a team subscription"
    invitation_email_message.set_content(
        f"You were added to subscription {subscription_id} with the role {role}."
    )

    with smtplib.SMTP(os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "localhost"), 587) as smtp_server_connection:
        smtp_server_connection.starttls()
        smtp_server_connection.login(os.environ["SMTP_USER"], os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
        smtp_server_connection.send_message(invitation_email_message)

    return f"Invited {invitee_email} to {subscription_id} as {role}"

tools.name: run_renewal_reminder_job
tools.description: Runs the renewal reminder script for subscriptions renewing within the given number of days and sends each affected customer a reminder email. Returns how many reminders were sent.

params.name: days_until_renewal
params.description: Remind customers whose subscription renews within this many days

params.name: dry_run
params.description: If true, the script only lists recipients and the emails are not sent

import json
import os
import smtplib
import subprocess
from email.message import EmailMessage

from agents import function_tool

SCRIPT_PATH = "/opt/billing/scripts/list_upcoming_renewals.py"


def _send_reminder(smtp_connection, recipient_email: str, plan_name: str, renewal_date: str, amount: str) -> None:
    message = EmailMessage()
    message["From"] = "billing@example.com"
    message["To"] = recipient_email
    message["Subject"] = f"Your {plan_name} plan renews on {renewal_date}"
    message.set_content(
        f"Your {plan_name} subscription will renew on {renewal_date} for {amount}. "
        "Manage your plan from your account settings."
    )
    smtp_connection.send_message(message)


@function_tool
def run_renewal_reminder_job(days_until_renewal: int, dry_run: bool = False) -> str:
    if days_until_renewal < 1 or days_until_renewal > 60:
        raise ValueError("days_until_renewal must be between 1 and 60")

    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["python3", SCRIPT_PATH, "--days", str(days_until_renewal), "--format", "json"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Renewal script failed: {completed.stderr.strip()}")

    upcoming_renewals = json.loads(completed.stdout)
    if dry_run:
        return f"Dry run: {len(upcoming_renewals)} reminders would be sent"

    sent_count = 0
    with smtplib.SMTP(os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "localhost"), 587) as smtp_connection:
        smtp_connection.starttls()
        smtp_connection.login(os.environ["SMTP_USER"], os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
        for renewal in upcoming_renewals:
            _send_reminder(
                smtp_connection,
                renewal["email"],
                renewal["plan_name"],
                renewal["renewal_date"],
                renewal["amount"],
            )
            sent_count += 1
    return f"Sent {sent_count} reminders"
